item.title: Pacearth Direct Recalls PACEARTH Swing Seats Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from May 2017 through June 2026 for between $27 and $57.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from May 2017 through June 2026 for between $27 and $57.
item.summary: This recall involves PACEARTH U-type swing seats. The swing seats were sold in various colors including green, blue, pink, red and turquoise. The chain is coated in yellow plastic. Metal carabiners or quick links and yellow webbing straps were included with the swing seats to attach the swing to outdoor swing sets or tree branches. The swing seats were sold as a single unit or a pack of two.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: PACEARTH Swing Seats.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled swing seats immediately and contact Pacearth Direct for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the swing seat with permanent marker, take a photo of it, including the PACEARTH logo and email to recall@pacearth.com.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
